title: Investigate the H3 w4a8 DiTs - is there a real win, and where do they land?
description:
BLOCKER HALVED 2026-08-21 - the text below blocks this on 'the 1.4 release AND GPU availability'. 1.4 shipped on 2026-08-10 and 1.4.2 followed on 2026-08-15, so only the GPU-availability half survives. Card stays blocked on that alone.

UMBRELLA: MPI-343 - Model upgrade evaluation queue (consolidation sweep 2026-08-14). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-343/plan.md.

BELONGS TO MPI-343, the model-upgrade evaluation queue - same shape as its PiD 1.5 and NSFW LTX 2.3 entries ("is the newer build actually a win?"). Evaluate it there; a separate investigation would re-derive the same method.

Kijai published w4a8_mixed builds of both H3 DiTs (fl2va 12.54GB, ref2va 11.77GB, vs 20.97GB int8_convrot each). Fabio ran one generation with the fl2va build and did NOT see much speed difference, so the win is unproven - investigate before deciding anything. Likely home if it ships is the Model Library quality tier. BLOCKED on the 1.4 release and on GPU availability (a Cubric-Prompt agent has it).
